title: Mindanao M7.8 Sentinel-2 Landslide Imagery — 66 Landslides, Multiple >500m Length
snippet: June 14, 2026 Sentinel-2 imagery confirms multiple large landslides exceeding 500m in length triggered by the June 8 M7.8 earthquake offshore Mindanao. NDRRMC reports 66 total landslides across affected areas. EOS Landslide Blog analysis with before/after satellite comparison.
tag_reason: evt-3201 Mindanao M7.8 tracked since 2026-06-09. Major update: Sentinel-2 optical imagery now available confirming 66 landslides, before/after comparison.
